text: In recognition of your daily efforts, we are conducting a special training drill that also provides a chance to refresh. This drill will take place in West Aelio. It will test your combat adaptability while lightly equipped, as well as your ability to coordinate while dispersed. Demonstrate your skills under the summer sun.

日々の奮闘を労い、リフレッシュを兼ねた特別演習を実施する。
舞台は西エアリオ。軽装状態での戦闘適応力と、分散状況下での連携を確認する。
夏の陽気の下、各自の実力を発揮せよ。
